Solxce requires your location to accurately map outdoor running and cycling paths, display real-time pace, and record workout distance.
Solxce uses your location in the background and foreground to track continuous outdoor run routes, splits, elevation gain, and live GPS telemetry even when your screen is locked.
Solxce requires continuous background location access to reliably record long-distance runs and marathon training sessions when your device is locked.
Solxce uses your camera to scan meal plates for instant AI macronutrient recognition and capture workout form videos and progress photos.
Solxce requires microphone access to record audio with your workout reels, training video clips, and voice notes for AI coach analysis.
Solxce accesses your photo library so you can select and post training reels, progress photos, and workout achievements to the community feed.
Solxce saves exported workout summaries, progress milestone cards, and running route recap graphics directly to your photo library.
Solxce reads your heart rate, active calories, resting energy, VO2 max, and step count from Apple Health to provide tailored athletic coaching and live telemetry.
Solxce writes your completed workout sessions, running splits, and nutritional intake data into Apple Health to keep your fitness history synchronized.
Solxce reads authorized health records to personalize recovery protocols and training loads based on your health background.
Solxce syncs your structured training calendar and scheduled workouts directly to your personal calendar.
Solxce requires full calendar access to create, update, and manage your scheduled athletic training sessions and race day events.
Solxce accesses your media library so you can select workout soundtracks and listen to motivational audio cues during training sessions.
Solxce uses motion sensors and pedometer data to track cadence, step count, and movement dynamics during workouts.
Solxce uses anonymized activity data to deliver personalized workout recommendations and improve fitness coaching algorithms.
Solxce uses Face ID to securely authenticate and safeguard your private fitness logs, biometric data, and account settings.
